Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.

We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.

The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.

This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. You'll own your projects from idea to P&L, working autonomously alongside a close-knit group of software engineers, quantitative researchers and expert traders.

So, if you feel energized by the intersection of markets, advanced analytics and trading technology and you want to help build something that moves power to where it’s needed the most, then we must talk.

Responsibilities

• Research and model the markets: Analyse energy market dynamics and turn your insights into predictive models that drive profitable trading strategies.

• Own the data: Build and maintain high-quality datasets that combine fundamental and real-time market data.

• Take strategies to production and keep them running: Own the path from research to live trading, shaping the systems, forecasting tools and data pipelines that run our strategies in real time. Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.

• Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.

• Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.

Who are you?

You have:

• Quantitative expertise: A track record of building accurate forecasting models and trading strategies for financial or energy markets, with a rigorous approach to research and validation.

• Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with full professional proficiency in English.

• Domain knowledge: A genuine interest in learning about power markets and systems. If you already have that domain knowledge, then that is a big plus.

• Education: An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

About Copenhagen Energy Trading

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.

We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.

Based in Copenhagen, we are building a collaborative, high-performance environment where talented people are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make an impact.

How to apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

If you have any questions, please contact Jens Christian Johannsen at jc@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

The Impact You'll Make

We welcome applications from both early-career and experienced engineers who bring strong technical curiosity, practical problem-solving skills, and a collaborative mindset.

**A Snapshot of Your Day

**For our Product Cybersecurity department, we are looking for an experienced, highly skilled and motivated Product Cybersecurity Architect to drive the definition and implementation of solution-wide security across exciting industrial product ranges. In this role, you will provide cybersecurity architecture expertise across multiple product and engineering domains, contribute to the development of cybersecurity standards and architectural principles, and work closely with development teams to strengthen the security and resilience of our products and solutions.

You will be part of Product Cybersecurity department, an international team of cybersecurity professionals united by a shared mission: enabling secure digitalization and ensuring that cybersecurity is built into products and solutions by design.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**

• Define and maintain overall cybersecurity architectural framework for products and solutions

• Establish and maintain cybersecurity principles, standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and secure development practices aligned with industry standards.

• Translate business, regulatory, and customer requirements into secure and scalable architectural solutions.

• Drive the adoption of Secure-by-Design principles and practices across products, solutions, and engineering processes.

• Facilitate cybersecurity architecture and design reviews, ensuring alignment with secure-by-design principles and organizational security objectives.

• Provide cybersecurity guidance on design and implementation to product development teams.

• Perform threat modeling and risk assessments at component, system, and solution levels.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to integrate cybersecurity requirements into product roadmaps, development processes, and engineering practices.

• Provide cybersecurity expertise and advisory support throughout customer projects, from proposal and design phases through implementation and delivery.

• Support cybersecurity certification, compliance, and assessment activities, including alignment with ISA/IEC 62443, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable requirements.

**What You Bring

**

• An academic degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Several years of experience in cybersecurity, product security, or OT cybersecurity in an architect, lead specialist, or similar role.

• Excellent technical security knowledge based on cybersecurity standards and good practices.

• Experience with widely recognized OT cybersecurity standards, including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and ISO 27001.

• Experience with threat modeling, risk assessment, and security architecture reviews.

• Experience with SCADA systems, Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and industrial communication networks.

• Knowledge of containerization and container orchestration security.

• Knowledge of cloud security principles and architecture.

• Understanding of AI-driven cybersecurity, including the use of AI in both offensive and defensive security contexts, and its implications for product security, threat detection, and secure system architecture.

• Fluency in English. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders

• Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

You are an ideal candidate, if you have:

• Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, or ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert.

• Knowledge of security and enterprise architecture frameworks such as SABSA and TOGAF.

• Experience with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to OT and connected products, including NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and NERC CIP.

• Experience with software supply chain security, SBOM governance, and vulnerability management processes.

Our mission is to develop standardized, high-quality, and scalable software products and services that strengthen the company’s digital foundation and create significant value for both internal and external customers.

By accelerating the delivery of new software engineering products and services, we help reduce time to market and contribute directly to Siemens Energy’s business success.

As part of the Product Cybersecurity team, you will play a key role in embedding cybersecurity into the design, development, and delivery of Siemens Energy's products and solutions, helping ensure they remain secure, resilient, and compliant in an evolving threat landscape. jobs.description:
The National Museum’s Conservation and Restoration unit is seeking a conservator for a 2-year project, focusing on recent wood conservation within the museum, with a focus on church furnishings and furniture.

Work areas

You will be part of a team of conservators with many specialties. Your main responsibility will be the conservation and documentation of wooden objects, furniture, and interiors, as well as the dismantling and assembly of interiors in historic buildings and churches. The tasks also include preventive conservation. The work is part of the unit’s revenue-generating business.

In addition, there may be tasks within the National Museum’s own exhibitions, involving work with installations, exhibition care, and possibly in our magazines.

Qualifications

We expect you to have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in conservation from a recognized educational institution or equivalent. In addition, we will emphasize that you have the following:

• Practical experience with the conservation of wooden objects or knowledge of traditional craft techniques within carpentry or furniture making

• Experience with the conservation of cultural and historical objects that are still in use. Specific experience with church furnishings is desirable, but not a requirement

• Experience with pest control, treatment of fungally infected wood and stabilization of decayed wood, including the conservation of wooden objects exhibited outdoors

• Experience with budgeting and time management

• Good teamwork skills

• Driving license (B)

Wage and employment conditions

The average working hours are 37 hours per week. We have flexible hours. Wage and employment conditions are determined according to the current collective agreement for academics in the State or the organizational agreement for technical employees.

The workplace is Brede north of Copenhagen. There will be business trips of shorter or longer periods in relation to specific projects.

The National Museum must have the opportunity to assess a criminal record for private use prior to employment.

The position is to be filled with effect from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is limited in time to 2 years.

Application

The National Museum’s ambition is to create a workplace where diversity is not only tolerated, but actively promoted and valued. We therefore encourage all qualified individuals, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

We are actively working to reduce bias in the recruitment process to ensure a diverse workforce and to ensure that we hire the most suitable candidates based on professional and personal qualifications. We therefore ask that you refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Written applications (in Danish or English) with information about education and previous employment should be sent via our electronic recruitment system on the National Museum’s website and must reach the museum no later than Tuesday, November 24, 2026.

We expect to hold job interviews at the beginning of week 49.

For further information regarding the position, please contact conservator Kim Alberdi at +45 41 20 65 94, kim.alberdi@natmus.dk or unit manager Eva Bøje Nielsen at + 45 41 20 65 70, eva.boje.nielsen@natmus.dk

Are you passionate about clinical trials and want to be involved in designing them? Do you have experience monitoring studies and analyzing data?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior Clinical Scientist Director, Clinical Development, Endocrine & Rare Diseases

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Senior Clinical Scientist to join our team. As a member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in designing, monitoring and analyzing clinical trials within the Endocrine and Rare Disease Medical Sciences area. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will join the Clinical Development team, being part of the Endocrine & Rare Disease Medical Sciences organization. You will report to the VP of Clinical Science who is based in the US. You will be based in Hellerup together with the Danish team.

• Ensure successful completion of documents (including clinical trial protocols, investigator brochures, monitoring plans, site training materials, clinical study reports, health authority responses, standard operating procedures, etc.) with cross-functional team members

• Participate in study teams and cross-functional teams as appropriate and as delegated

• Ensure consistent use of language and criteria across multiple endocrine projects

• Ensure study integrity and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Anticipate obstacles within a clinical trial and implement solutions

• Analyze, evaluate, and support accurate interpretation and reporting of clinical data

• Contribute to drafting and reviewing clinical documents, manuscripts, presentations, and regulatory submissions

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant science, medical information, good clinical practices, and regulatory guidance

• Collaborate with—and serve as a clinical research resource for—cross-functional colleagues to optimize product development

• Cultivate relationships with investigative sites, clinical consultants, and key opinion leaders to represent the interests of the company

• Complete assigned tasks thoroughly, accurately, and on time

• Adhere to rigorous ethical standards

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant degree, e.g., cand.pharm/Msc in Pharmacy or equivalent. You also have a strong track record of scientific and clinical inquiry.

Furthermore, you:

• Understand statistical concepts and clinical trial design

• Understand the connection between nonclinical data and clinical data

• Take initiative and solve problems of moderate complexity

• Demonstrate sound judgement in terms of handling complex, confidential, and regulated information

Below experience is preferred but not required:

• At least 4 years of experience with clinical trial design and execution

• At least 4 years of pharmaceutical industry experience

• Experience with regulatory submissions and interactions

Key competencies:

You have a proven ability to learn quickly, even in fast‑paced environments and remaining organized with attention to details.

You take ownership of your work, lead by example, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across the organization. You are trusted by others for your sound judgment and discretion, particularly when handling confidential, sensitive, or regulated information.

To succeed in this position, we expect you to have excellent communications skills as well as being a team member who thrives in collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders.

Travel: 20-30 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important

**The Principal SaaS Solution Advisor plays a critical role in supporting the growth of SimCorp's SaaS and SimCorp One offerings across new and existing client opportunities. Working closely with Sales, Account Management, and internal product and delivery teams, you act as a trusted advisor to prospects — guiding them through the strategic, commercial, and operational considerations of adopting a cloud-hosted, managed investment management platform.

Your focus is to shape and progress opportunities across the full presales lifecycle, from initial discovery and solution scoping through to RFP responses, tailored demonstrations, and competitive positioning. You bring both deep product fluency across SimCorp's evolving portfolio and genuine industry expertise, enabling you to engage credibly at the senior level and position SimCorp's SaaS and SimCorp One offering as a compelling answer to the challenges reshaping the investment management industry.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Discovery & Scoping

**

• Engage prospects in structured discovery to understand their operating model, technology estate, regulatory environment, and strategic priorities.

• Translate functional and non-functional requirements into an indicative SaaS or SimCorp One solution scope, covering platform configuration, data services, connectivity, and managed service boundaries.

• Identify and document client-specific pain points and map them to SimCorp differentiators — including the SimCorp One open platform model, continuous delivery, and the reduced total cost of ownership relative to on-premise alternatives.

• Surface potential fit gaps early and provide structured feedback to Product and SaaS Operations.

**RFPs & Commercial Responses

**

• Lead or contribute to RFP responses for SaaS and SimCorp One opportunities, with focus on deployment model, service levels, data residency, security posture, and total cost of ownership.

• Articulate the SaaS and SimCorp One commercial model clearly — subscription structure, included services, upgrade inclusion, and open ecosystem positioning — in a way that resonates with procurement, finance, and technology stakeholders.

• Build and maintain a knowledge base of SaaS and SimCorp One RFP responses, keeping content current and aligned with contractual and operational commitments.

**Workshops, Scoping & Solution Validation

**

• Plan and deliver tailored workshops, scoping sessions, and architecture design discussions that help prospects understand the SimCorp One SaaS operating model, deployment approach, and managed service boundaries.

• Prepare and present compelling service descriptions, solution presentations, and platform overviews — adapting content and depth to the audience, from operational teams to C-level stakeholders.

• Design and facilitate workshops covering topics such as the shared responsibility model, release management, environment strategy, and the SimCorp One partner and data ecosystem.

• Where appropriate, support Solution Validation engagements, defining scope and success criteria aligned to the prospect's decision framework.

**SimCorp One & SaaS Proposition

**

• Develop and maintain deep knowledge of SimCorp One — its open platform architecture, API-first design, partner integrations, and the strategic direction of moving clients from on-premise deployments toward a composable, cloud-native operating model.

• Articulate clearly how SimCorp One differs from traditional SaaS delivery: the ability to connect third-party solutions, consume data services, and operate within a broader fintech ecosystem while retaining SimCorp Dimension as the investment book of record.

• Engage confidently with CTO, COO, and CIO-level stakeholders on cloud strategy, platform extensibility, vendor dependency, and the long-term operating model implications of the SimCorp One platform.

• Understand and articulate the value of SimCorp One Neo — SimCorp's embedded AI layer — including its agentic workflows, prompt library, and human-in-the-loop design, and position these capabilities as part of the broader SaaS and SimCorp One value proposition in client conversations.

**How You Contribute To The Team

**

• Partner closely with Sales Specialists and Account Management to ensure consistent and compelling messaging to prospects and business partners.

• Provide feedback on competitive positioning and product gaps based on prospect and market insights.

• Coordinate with broader presales and delivery colleagues to ensure continuity and quality across the opportunity lifecycle.

• Contribute to the ongoing improvement of SaaS and SimCorp One Solution Advisory tooling, decks and material.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you see yourself thriving in the role described above. How you acquired the relevant skills matters less than your ability and willingness to apply them and continue learning.

Ideally, you bring experience in several of the following areas:

• A minimum of 7 years’ experience in investment management technology, in a presales, solution advisory, or senior implementation capacity.

• Deep understanding of buy-side operating models across asset managers, asset owners, insurance companies, or wealth managers — including front-to-back investment workflows, data management, and the pressures driving technology transformation.

• Fluency in industry trends such as fee compression, the shift to alternatives, T+1 settlement, cloud adoption, and evolving regulatory frameworks (e.g. DORA, AIFMD, MiFID).

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer for Centre for Software Technology (CST)
jobs.description:
Centre for Software Technology (CST), part of the Software Engineering units at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, located in Vejle, invites applications for an engineering position to support the buildup of the Centre and supporting laboratories. The centre is a newly started center that focuses on software engineering, interaction technology and AI research and education in close cooperation with companies to utilize the potential in digitalization. It is expected that the centre will experience a significant growth over the next five years.

The Centre for Software Technology (CST) at SDU is a part of the new campus, SDU Vejle, home of excellence within information technology. The academic focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is to conduct research in interactive information technology and software engineering. The areas will be complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The centre is involved in a variety of research and collaboration projects nationally and internationally. The centre has a strong collaboration with industry to solve challenging research problems from real applications, and to participate in implementing the achieved results into real solutions with end users. The work in the centre is structured around a number of laboratories.

The work and responsibilities for the applicant will be within the areas of:

• 
Prototyping interactive technologies such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, circuits, microcontrollers, soldering, sensors, and actuators

• 
Software development in relation to advanced interaction technologies, intelligent systems, cyber-physical systems, e.g. in the areas of critical infrastructure and healthcare systems

• 
Developing and maintaining infrastructures to support the laboratories in close collaboration with the associated researchers

• 
Support for research and educational activities

• 
Managing lab space including inventory, supplies and materials, space maintenance and organization, developing and enforcing safety procedures, providing and managing training for specialized fabrication equipment

• 
Digital/physical fabrication with laser cutters, 3D printers, 3D modeling, making enclosures for interactive electronics, making professional robust physical artifacts

• 
Facilitating and participation in business development in collaboration with local industry and municipality

• 
Using AI technologies effectively, ethically and systematically in the context of engineering applications 

The applicant we are looking for should have one or more of the following competencies:

• 
Experience with collaboration projects that involve industry and academia

• 
Experience with implementing software solutions in a variety of programming languages

• 
Experience with managing a lab space including managing training for specialized fabrication equipment.

• 
Experience with prototyping interactive technologies and digital/physical fabrication

• 
Experience with software development processes and methods

• 
Experience with infrastructures to support software development (e.g. Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud infrastructures)

• 
Experience with the development of middleware, services, micro services, and databases

• 
Experience with Generative AI and Prompt Engineering, e.g. tailoring effective prompts to instruct LLMs; knowing the dos and don’ts of GenAI from ethical angles 

• 
Experience with data engineering including the use of machine learning frameworks with software such as PyTorch and TensorFlow

It is expected that the candidate has documented qualifications related to the position, for example, shown by a degree in the field of software engineering, interaction technologies, computer engineering, computer science or similar or previous related job positions.

A candidate should be able to achieve a Danish security clearance to take part in the development of critical technology.

We offer a dynamic and diverse work environment with a large variety of tasks, and you will be given the opportunity to work on different research projects applying your skills within the software domain. It is expected that you can work in a team, but also solve your tasks independently.

Further information is available from LEGO® Chair and Professor Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard, mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk, +45 2197 2447.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Positions within Mobile Robotics at SDU Robotics
jobs.description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within mobile robotics. We therefore invite applications for one or more postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

What we offer

• 
An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

• 
Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

• 
Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to the mobile robotics lab specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automated agriculture as well as related applications that require mobility in open terrain. We expect that the research activities involve both computer vision for scene understanding, tracking of relevant artefacts, as well as the integration and development of AI-based solutions for autonomous operation in scenarios within, e.g., field processing. The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in testing facilities at SDU as well as project partners and head the evaluation efforts in collaboration with a consortium of interdisciplinary project partners. 

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching and supervision responsibilities could also be part of employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

• 
Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics.

• 
Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

• 
Supporting the team in securing external funding.

• 
Participation in ongoing and future research projects.

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to mobile robots controlled with multimodal feedback. The candidates are hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

• 
Expert knowledge with ROS2 and relevant modules such as the Nav2

• 
Strong knowledge in multi-object tracking

• 
Experience in simulation of robotic systems

• 
Experience in design, development and integration of robotic systems

Furthermore, the successful candidates are expected to:

• 
Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

• 
Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

• 
Have the ability of working independently.

• 
Have a strong sense of responsibility.

• 
Conduct independent research. 

Research environment

The candidates will be integrated in the unit SDU Robotics. We are a team of approximately 60 researchers and engineers based in Odense. We actively work across traditional disciplinary boundaries to develop new technologies and scientific knowledge. Our research contributes to novel solutions with applications in welfare, industrial automation, lab automation, and healthcare. Furthermore, the unit has a long-standing tradition of collaboration with industrial partners.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics.

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international working environment with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher within the field of robotics. 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Associate Professor Leon Bodenhagen lebo@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

• 
Verified copies of official certificates/diplomas and transcripts of exams (MSc and PhD), both the original documents and in professional English translation.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position, may also be included. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

Employment terms

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

This postdoc position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
